NL01: The system starts in the DoorsClosing state and transitions to InMotion when the doors are closed, triggered by the "Closed/SendDeparted" signal.

In the InMotion state, the system can either transition to the Stopping state when it arrives, indicated by the "Arrived/Stop, Send Arrived" signal, or to the EmergencyStopping state if an obstacle is detected.
When an obstacle is detected, the system enters the EmergencyStopping state, which includes the actions "Emergency Stop" and sends the "Obstacle Detected" signal.
Within the InMotion state, the system operates in three substates: Accelerating, Cruising, and Approaching, which represent different phases of the train's motion.
The system begins in the Accelerating substate, moving to the Cruising substate once cruising speed is reached, as indicated by the "Reached Cruising/Cruise" signal.
If the system is in the Accelerating substate and approaches its destination, it transitions to the Approaching substate upon receiving the "Approached/Decelerate" signal.
The system in the Cruising substate transitions to the Approaching substate when it approaches the destination, triggered by the "Approached/Decelerate" signal.
The system enters the Accelerating substate when motion begins, marked by the "Entry/Accelerate" action.
In the Approaching substate, the system sends the "Send" signal and continues to approach the destination.
The system remains in the Approaching substate while nearing the destination, until it is ready to stop or decelerate.
NL08: S1 [原文标号 "1"] The human driving mode is represented by a simple state.
S2 [原文标号 "2"] The autonomous mode has sub-states and is represented by a sub machine state.
S3 [原文标号 "3."] when power on, the system turn into human driving mode
S4 [原文标号 "4"（无点，与下一句同号）] when front_distance > 10, auto transport to autonomous state
S5 [原文标号 "4."（与上一句同号）] transit to human driving mode when receive human steering cmd, brake pressed, in (auto final)
S6 [原文标号 "5"] when power off, it will transit to final state

nl08_numbering_note: NL08 的 nl.txt 是单行连写，标号序列为 1, 2, 3., 4, 4., 5——共 6 个子句但只有 5 个互异标号（'4' 出现两次：'4when front_distance > 10...' 与 '4. transit to human driving mode...'）。本次复核统一采用**位置编号 S1..S6**，并在每条句子里保留原文标号做映射：S1='1', S2='2', S3='3.', S4='4'(front_distance), S5='4.'(接管三条件), S6='5'(power off)。理由：原审阅稿的 '第5句' 在不同条目里指两个不同子句——0000/d5 与 0020/d4 的 '第5句' 指接管三条件（位置第 5 句、标号 '4.'），而 0010/d6、0030/d3、0040/d2 的 '第5句' 指 power off（标号 '5'、位置第 6 句）；任务背景说明里 '第 4 句' 也同时被用于 front_distance 与接管子句。只有位置编号能唯一消歧，故本报告一律用 S1..S6，并按内容逐条重新绑定审阅者的引用。
